The '''Director of Fleet Intelligence''' was the individual in charge of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Defense Force's]] [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence|Fleet Intelligence]] service. The position was held by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grif]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] and years later by [[Ayddar Nylykerka]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
